claims.text: The as-cast NbMoCrTiAl alloy has a coarse microstructure.
The as-cast NbMoCrTiAl alloy contains minimal in-situ reinforcement phases.
The conventional composite is produced by 39 h of high-energy planetary ball milling followed by SPS at 1700 °C under 30 MPa.
The conventionally processed NbMoCrTiAl composite has a room-temperature compressive fracture strength of 1542 MPa.
The conventional composite's compressive strength is approximately 50% higher than that of the as-cast NbMoCrTiAl alloy.
The conventional composite exhibits cleavage-type fracture without room-temperature ductility.
The conventional process produces relatively coarse TiC and Al2O3 reinforcement phases.
Reducing or otherwise adjusting milling and tailoring SPS parameters will promote finer, uniformly dispersed, nanoscale, and less-brittle ceramic precipitates.
The modified process will reduce the alloy's grain size.
Nanoscale ceramic reinforcement particles will impede dislocation motion and thereby strengthen the alloy.
Grain refinement will increase the effective Young's modulus.
Grain refinement will increase the alloy's strength.
A homogeneous nanoscale particle dispersion will mitigate crack propagation and improve fracture resistance.
Minimizing brittle, coarse phases will prevent reinforcement particles from acting as crack-initiation sites and improve ductility.
The optimized material will maintain or exceed approximately 1500 MPa compressive strength.
The optimized material will have greater strain to failure than the conventional composite.
The optimized material will have a higher effective Young's modulus than the conventional composite.
The optimized material will have greater fracture toughness or fracture resistance than the conventional composite.
The proposed improvement should hold only when alloy chemistry permits formation of a less-brittle nanoscale reinforcement phase and processing avoids coarsening or segregation.
The room-temperature improvements may not persist at high operating temperatures if phase stability is compromised.
